headline: State Street Warns Banks on Responsible AI Deployment Risks
summary: State Street emphasized the need for responsible deployment as the financial industry races to adopt artificial intelligence agents amid security risks.
why: Financial institutions face operational and cybersecurity risks as they integrate automated artificial intelligence agents across banking workflows.

impacts.name: State Street Corporation
impacts.why: State Street is the institution calling for responsible AI deployment in banking.
